Coram:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal

1. Pursuant to the previous order dated 29th August, 2024, additional documents have been filed by
the counsel for the petitioner, which are on record of this Court.

2. This petition has been filed seeking quashing of Fir No.343/2022 dated 06th June 2022, Ps
Ghazipur, under Sections 498A/406/34 Ipc.
3.
Counsel for petitioner contends that respondent No.2 is the sister-in- law (bhabhi) of the petitioner who had married the petitioner's brother.
Through the said FIR, false and frivolous allegations have been made against the petitioner with the ulterior motive to harass and humiliate her.
He contends that respondent No.2 has always threatened the petitioner to

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 31/01/2025 at 21:40:02 implicate her under false charges in criminal cases.

4. The marriage of the petitioner's brother and respondent No.2 was solemnised on 25th February,
2020.
There was issue of marital discord between the petitioner's brother and respondent No.2.

It is contended in the petition that in the entire chargesheet, no specific allegations have been made by respondent No.2 against the petitioner, in any specific dates or events, and a false case has been concocted.
5. Accordingly, issue notice.

sentences.text: Notice is accepted by ASC on behalf of the State.

7. On steps being taken by the petitioner, issue notice to respondent No.2 as well, through all permissible modes, including email.
8.
Counsel for the petitioner pleads for an exemption from appearance before the Trial Court considering that the petitioner is a lady of about 39 years with two minor children to take care of.
9. Needless to state, the petitioner will be at liberty to take up this plea before the Trial Court, which shall be decided in accordance with law.

10. List on 07th April, 2025.
11.
Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J JANUARY 7, 2025/MK/sc
